select "type", count(*) from "notifications" where (("notifications"."org_id" = ? and "notifications"."user_id" = ?) and "notifications"."read_at" is null and ("notifications"."done_at" is null and ("notifications"."snoozed_until" is null or "notifications"."snoozed_until" <= ?))) group by "notifications"."type"
